data: {"type":"response.function_call_arguments.delta","item_id":"fc_39cf81f9","output_index":2,"delta":"\"command\": \"set -u\\nmkdir -p /tmp/mdt\\n# 1) line deletion\\ngrep -v 'beam sweeping' a.txt > /tmp/mdt/del.txt\\necho '=== delete line 2 ==='; python3 tools/minidiff.py a.txt /tmp/mdt/del.txt; echo \\\"exit=$?\\\"\\n# 2) line insertion after line 1\\n{ head -1 a.txt; echo 'Gulls wheeled overhead, indifferent to the light.'; tail -n +2 a.txt; } > /tmp/mdt/ins.txt\\necho '=== insert line after 1 ==='; python3 tools/minidiff.py a.txt /tmp/mdt/ins.txt; echo \\\"exit=$?\\\"\\n# 3) empty vs one line\\n: > /tmp/mdt/empty.txt; printf 'hello world\\\\n' > /tmp/mdt/one.txt\\necho '=== empty vs one line ==='; python3 tools/minidiff.py /tmp/mdt/empty.txt /tmp/mdt/one.txt; echo \\\"exit=$?\\\"\\n# 4) first- and last-word substitution\\nprintf 'alpha beta gamma\\\\n' > /tmp/mdt/f1; printf 'ALPHA beta GAMMA\\\\n' > /tmp/mdt/f2\\necho '=== first/last word ==='; python3 tools/minidiff.py /tmp/mdt/f1 /tmp/mdt/f2; echo \\\"exit=$?\\\"\\n# 5) two far-apart changes -> separate hunks\\n{ head -1 a.txt; sed -n 2p a.txt; sed -n 3p a.txt; sed -n 4p a.txt; sed 's/still/calm/' a.txt | tail -1; sed 's/^The/Xhe/' a.txt | head -0; } > /dev/null\\n{ sed '1s/granite/basalt/' a.txt | head -0; } > /dev/null\\n{ sed '1s/granite/basalt/' a.txt; sed -n 2,4p a.txt; sed '5s/still/calm/' a.txt | sed -n 1p; } > /tmp/mdt/far.txt\\npython3 - <<'EOF'\\n# build far.txt: change line 1 and line 5 only\\nlines = open('a.txt').read().splitlines()\\nlines[0] = lines[0].replace('granite', 'basalt')\\nlines[4] = lines[4].replace('still', 'calm')\\nopen('/tmp/mdt/far.txt', 'w').write('\\\\n'.join(lines) + '\\\\n')\\nEOF\\necho '=== far apart changes ==='; python3 tools/minidiff.py a.txt /tmp/mdt/far.txt; echo \\\"exit=$?\\\"\"","sequence_number":70,"model":"qwen3.8-27b"}
